_note: Supply Chain module config (lib/supply-chain.js). Thresholds/approvers are Exo defaults pending Jon's confirmation (Decision filed 2026-10-01). Flowdowns are incorporated by reference; counsel review recommended before the first government-funded PO.

approval.rule: Jon approves (Decision card) when total >= threshold, flight-critical, supplier DD not cleared, or ASL override. Otherwise any admin except the requester approves in MC.

flowdowns.title: Exos standard purchase order terms and conditions; supplier represents it is not excluded on SAM.gov or listed on the Consolidated Screening List
Certificate of Conformance required with each shipment, signed by an authorized supplier quality representative
First Article Inspection per AS9102 on first production, and after any design, process, facility, or sub-tier change
Lot/serial traceability to raw material; material certifications (mill/test reports) furnished with shipment
Right of access for Exos, its customers, and regulatory authorities to facilities and records involved in this order

Supplier shall notify Exos of nonconformances and obtain Exos approval for nonconforming product disposition; notify of changes in process, facility, or sub-tier source; no substitution without written approval
Counterfeit part prevention (AS5553 / AS6174); parts sourced from OCM or authorized distributors only
Quality records retained a minimum of 10 years and available to Exos on request
Foreign Object Debris (FOD) prevention per AS9146
Applicable requirements of this order flowed down to sub-tier suppliers
Prohibition on Requiring Certain Internal Confidentiality Agreements or Statements
